title: Corn at the Store
lines: Meg went to the store for corn.
The store had no more corn at all.
A man told Meg to try the farm.
Meg ran on a short path to the farm.
She had to hop past sharp thorns.
The corn was tall next to the barn.
Meg got a big bag of it.
She ran back home before dark.
Dad cut up the corn for a snack.
It was the best corn of all.

questions.ask: Why did Meg go to the farm?
questions.listenFor: The store had no more corn, and a man told her to try the farm. Two steps, so let them reread if they only get one.

questions.ask: What did Meg have to hop past on the way?
questions.listenFor: Sharp thorns on the short path. It is one line, and it is the line most kids skim.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg was glad she went? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason, like the last line about the best corn, or the long walk past the thorns.
